# opnsense_zenarmor_interfaces (Data Source)

Lists interfaces exposed by the local Zenarmor status controller.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opnsense_zenarmor_interfaces" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable identifier for this interface collection.
- `interfaces` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--interfaces))

<a id="nestedatt--interfaces"></a>
### Nested Schema for `interfaces`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Interface description when advertised by Zenarmor.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the Zenarmor agent is enabled.
- `id` (String) Stable local interface identifier.
- `monitored` (Boolean) Whether the interface appears in Zenarmor's monitored interface list.
- `name` (String) OPNsense interface name.
- `tags` (List of String) Deterministically ordered Zenarmor tags.
